name: What preparation is needed before backsplash tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before backsplash tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a lasting backsplash installation. This typically involves clearing the counter space, protecting adjacent areas with drop cloths, and ensuring the wall surface is clean, dry, and flat. Any existing backsplash or loose paint must be removed, and the wall should be repaired and primed if necessary. Ensuring outlets are removed and electrical boxes are extended is also part of the preparation, allowing tiles to be installed seamlessly around them. Thorough preparation minimizes potential issues and ensures a smooth, durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes clearing counters, protecting surfaces, ensuring the wall is clean and flat, removing old backsplashes, and addressing electrical outlets.
